body.text: A disagreeable piece of news from {param:town}. They will not deal in {param:resource} — not buy it of the Crown, not sell it to the Crown, not at the duty of {param:rate} in the hundred nor at any other.
They have put it about that this is a matter of principle. It is a matter of sixpence.
The returns being {perception:purse}, I would not have chosen this month for it.
There is no order that ends it. They will trade again when it suits them, and what would suit them is a lower duty — which I need hardly say I do not recommend.
You will lower the duty, I expect. You generally do.
I have not asked their governor to intervene. He could not if he wished to; it is not his decision and never was.
